name: KTH Scholarship (Sweden)
funding: Full tuition for a one- or two-year KTH master's (year two if your first-year results are good) for fee-paying students who put KTH first; living costs are not included.
deadline: Autumn 2027: scholarship form Dec 1, 2026 – Jan 15, 2027, after applying to KTH as your first choice on universityadmissions.se
